avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may increase triamcinolone metabolism and reduce efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue St. John's Wort or consider alternative corticosteroid therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immunosuppressive effects and increase infection risk with triamcinolone
avoid_supplements.action: Advise against use during triamcinolone therapy; monitor for signs of infection

caution_supplements.name: Licorice Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mineralocorticoid activity may additive with triamcinolone, increasing hypertension and hypokalemia risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and electrolytes; limit licorice root duration and dose

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase blood glucose levels; triamcinolone also elevates glucose
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose in diabetic patients; use cautiously with dose adjustment if needed

caution_foods.name: High sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Triamcinolone increases sodium retention; excessive dietary sodium may compound fluid retention and hypertension
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate sodium restriction; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase triamcinolone exposure, though clinical significance is minimal for this agent
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased corticosteroid side effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, hypertension, and infection risk as triamcinolone causes immunosuppression and metabolic effects. Counsel on adequate calcium, vitamin D, and protein intake to mitigate osteoporosis risk with long-term use.
